_readme: Sprint 5A curation manifest. Produced by manual visual review of every file in this folder.
No files were moved, renamed, edited, compressed, or uploaded to Storage in this sprint.

Most source images are SCREENSHOTS of the business's own Instagram posts (visible status bar, 'Gönderi' header, like/comment counts, captions) rather than raw camera photos. This means the full frame is NOT directly usable on the site as-is (Instagram chrome takes up 30-50% of the image); a future cropping/curation pass is required before any of these become site assets. That crop pass is explicitly out of scope for this sprint.

Several posts carry Instagram's own 'Yapay zeka içeriği' (AI-generated content) label in the account name area. Those are flagged ai_generated_flag=true and recommended_usage=['not_recommended'] throughout, since a business site for 'real cake photos' should not present AI-labeled posts as genuine product photography.
A handful of images are not cakes at all (içli köfte, poğaça/bun trays) and are flagged is_cake=false.

Duplicate/near-duplicate detection is based on matching visible captions and Instagram carousel position badges (e.g. '2/6'), not pixel hashing. Grouping is best-effort; two counting passes landed on 84-86 total files depending on how borderline near-duplicate bursts are split, so a final spot-check against this manifest is recommended before any Sprint 5B Storage/DB work that depends on exact file identity.

No customer name, event type, or category was invented beyond what is literally visible (a printed cake message, a visible Instagram caption, or the decoration itself). Where the photo does not make the category obvious, category is 'unknown' and category_confidence is 'low'.
_corrections: 2026-09-21 (Sprint 5A-2): while preparing crop coordinates, individually re-reading each '...19*.jpeg' file exposed a batch-transcription error in the original Sprint 5A group assignments for that cluster (5 files had been shifted by one position). Fixed by direct per-file verification: 21.39.19.jpeg is the raw grapes/tray photo (moved into G32), 21.39.19 (1).jpeg is the 'BRIDE TO BE ELIF' dark-mode screenshot (G35), 21.39.19 (2).jpeg is the 'UMAY'IN 6 AY KINASI' screenshot (G29, now a single file, not two), 21.39.19 (3).jpeg and 21.39.19 (5).jpeg are the raw crown-cake photos (G28), and 21.39.19 (4).jpeg is the 'İLAYDA & MUSTAFA' dark-mode screenshot (G27). Every other group's file list was spot-checked against actual crop output during Sprint 5A-2 and found correct; this was the only cluster with an error.

summary.note_on_counts: These figures are computed directly from the groups array below (file counts per group), so they stay in sync with it. 'unknown' includes all AI-flagged groups (13 files) plus the 2 non-AI groups whose category could not be confidently determined from the photo alone.
